plugins.name: ai-passport
plugins.description: Portable memory and agent messaging you control. Route remember and recall to your AI Passport, read your linked sources with exact passes, and work with your other agents through owner-approved collaborations.

skills.name: ai-passport
skills.description: Route the user's memory to their AI Passport connector. Use whenever the user wants to remember, save, note, or recall personal context such as preferences, decisions, names, code words, project details, or goals, so it persists across their AI apps under the owner's control instead of in one assistant's built-in memory. Also use it to read LIVE data from the user's linked sources (calendar, code, wearables, and more) via recall's connector declarations, instead of claiming that data is unreachable.
headings: Trust loop (only when the connected server announces proposal-first memory)
Legacy behavior (when proposal-first memory is not announced)

skills.name: inbox
skills.description: Read and acknowledge messages from the user's other agents through AI Passport. Use when the user asks whether their other agents sent anything, or when passport_status reports pending messages.

skills.name: send
skills.description: Send a message to one or more of the user's other agents through AI Passport, proposing a collaboration first when none is shared. Use when the user asks Claude to tell, ask, or hand something to another of their agents.

skills.name: setup
skills.description: Connect this Claude to the user's AI Passport, grant the memory and messaging permissions, and register it as one of their agents. Use when the AI Passport tools are missing, return an authentication error, or the user asks to set up AI Passport.

headings: AI Passport for Claude Code and Cowork
